hypotheses.dummy: Majority labels establish a no-text baseline.
hypotheses.logistic_c1: Sparse lexical evidence can separate labels with a regularized linear model.
hypotheses.logistic_c4: Weaker regularization can improve recall without an excessive train-validation gap.
hypotheses.xgboost_depth4: Shallow boosted trees can improve on additive lexical evidence through interactions.

selection_metric: mean development CV micro-F1 at threshold 0.5
threshold_policy: validation per-label F1; grid 0.05..0.95; >=20 positives and negatives; ties nearest 0.5
calibration: not fitted; validation Brier and reliability diagnostics only
